name: generate
description: Generate an Evie enclosure-class solid (badge, cover, or faceplate) via CopilotCAD OCCT builders. Pass part and/or inline_spec (YAML/JSON object or string). Dogfood only — not product print-GO.

part.description: Which parametric part to build. Required unless inline_spec names exactly one public part.

inline_spec.description: Machine-readable enclosure spec as a YAML/JSON string, object, or file path. Gates later score against this contract. Geometry still comes from checked-in OCCT builders.

token.description: Bot token. Default stub is local-dogfood (or COPILOTCAD_BOT_TOKEN). Required only when the env token is customized.
